Rationale.RP1_ImplementationReconstructability: The experiment can be reconstructed from plan.md and CodeWalkthrough.md without missing steps. The plan provides clear methodology (Post-LN transformer zero ablation, puzzle evaluation metrics), and the code walkthrough gives step-by-step instructions. Source code in src/leela_logit_lens/ is well-documented with explicit ablation logic.
Rationale.RP2_EnvironmentReproducibility: Environment fully reproducible. Dependencies specified in pyproject.toml. Model files (lc0-original.onnx, 361MB) and puzzles (interesting_puzzles.pkl, 22517 samples) are available in iteration_model/. Experiment ran successfully on CUDA (A100 GPU). External data can be downloaded from provided Figshare links.
Rationale.RP3_DeterminismAndStability: Results are deterministic with seed control (np.random.seed(42)). PyTorch inference is deterministic with torch.no_grad() and model.eval(). Same seed produces identical puzzle sampling and solve rates. Argmax move selection ensures no stochastic variation in evaluation.
